text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager alert — sustained 5xx spike on inference-gateway /v1/complete (region: ap-south-1). error-rate 21% over 4m, p95 latency up 3x. Potential runtime crashes reported.

lee: I'm paged, grabbing on-call.

tara: Oncall here. Checking traces and host health.

dev-li: Runtime reports OOMs + SIGSEGVs in kv_allocator.cpp at flush_window(). A few model-runner pods restarted by kernel OOM killer. Sample kernel log: 

dev-li: ```
Apr 12 03:14:21 ap-runner-12 kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 9217 (model-runner) score 1024 or sacrifice child
Apr 12 03:14:22 ap-runner-12 model-runner[9217]: segfault at 0 ip 00007fe4a3f2d sp 00007ffd8e9b error 4 in model_runner_kv.so[7fe4a3000+1d000]
```

ops-jen: Quick customer impact check: Support flagged Shoply pipeline failures and TransitAI streaming retries. Alex?

support-alex: Shoply batch jobs failed for ~10m; TransitAI saw degraded streaming with reconnects. Tickets created: SHOP-2026-77, TRANS-2026-14.

lee: Initial mitigation proposal: 1) cordon/drain affected ap-runner-12/13/15; 2) divert 100% new traffic to ap-runner-b pool; 3) disable quant-vicuna-70b-lite rollout in ap; 4) enable fallback to vicuna-13b-small for requests > 2048 tokens; 5) collect cores and heap profiles.

deploy-bot: @lee execute: `infra pool drain ap-runner-12 --grace 20s` (ok). `infra pool drain ap-runner-13 --grace 20s` (ok).

dev-li: Also toggling runtime flag runtime.kv.defer_flush=false to force eager flush (temporary) and runtime.kv.max_prefix=4096 to limit growth.

tara: Rolling back quant-vicuna-70b-lite rollout in ap: `deploy revert --model quant-vicuna-70b-lite --region ap-south-1 --to rev-2026-02-10`

deploy-bot: revert started -> success on 6/6 hosts.

lee: Observability: error rate dropped from 21% -> 3.5% within 90s after reroute+rollback. p95 improves. Still seeing a residual OOM on a pod finishing tasks.

dev-li: Captured a reproducer: streaming client sending many intermittent long chunks (6-8k tokens) triggers incremental KV allocations + flush race leading to invalid free. Repro steps saved in /artifacts/4958762345/repro.md and container at s3://incidents-builds/4958762345/repro.tar.gz.

ops-jen: Scaling ap-runner-b +3 nodes to handle diverted traffic.

dev-li: Quick root cause theory: new quant layout introduced a different mmap-backed KV slab allocator. Under heavy long-context streaming pattern and aggressive scale-down behavior, freed regions get re-mapped and a delayed flush path frees an already-evicted pointer. Causes segfault/double-free and then OOM cascades.

tara: Autoscaler note: we had lowered scale-down cooldown earlier today to 60s. That likely made nodes churn under bursty traffic. Reverting to 10m cooldown for the pool.

support-alex: Communicating to Shoply/TransitAI: interim update sent, noting mitigation and ETA for RCA in 48-72h. Offering one-time credit.

lee: For live mitigation now: keep rollback, keep diverted traffic for 30m, keep kv.max_prefix enforced, revert autoscaler cooldown, and plan a hotfix.

dev-li: Working on hotpatch branch li/kv-safefree-4958: add ownership flags, double-free guards, and fallback no-op on stale pointer in flush_window(). Running ASAN + CI reproducer.

tara: Collecting artifacts: cores uploaded to s3://redwood-incidents/4958762345/cores/, heap snapshots to s3://redwood-incidents/4958762345/heap/, and logs to /artifacts/4958762345/logs.tar.gz.

lee: Handoff notes: assign RCA to dev-li. Postmortem actions: INF-4999 (repro + fix), INF-5000 (regression test for long streaming contexts), OPER-312 (autoscaler cooldown policy revert), COMMS-930 (customer follow-ups).

dev-li: Pushing hotpatch for CI: if green, will cherry-pick to ap rollback channel and bump canary.

ops-jen: Notifying billing for credits.

incident-bot: Incident status -> mitigated. Severity: page -> incident. Duration: 12m. Impacted: Shoply (10m errors), TransitAI (7m degraded). RCA owner: dev-li. Postmortem due in 72h.

lee: Closing live coordination. Will keep thread open for postmortem notes. Last check at 4958762465.
